We're taking you to Flachau 🏔️
This is where Tesla Takeover Europe is happening, and we wanted to show you around 🎥
Welcome to the Musistadl 🤍

Outside we've got a huge area for you. The sponsors, the vendors, the tuning area, and a brand new kids zone with a playground for the little ones 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
And inside the Musistadl? That's where the magic happens. Our stage. All the talks. This part is tickets only, so grab yours if you haven't yet 🎟️
Ticket holders also get parking and our shuttle service. We'll show you exactly where to go, and the views on the way are something else 👀
Filmed with our new drone from Antigravity 🚁
Now we just need the weather to play along 😄

See you June 5 and 6 in Flachau. We can't wait to host you fam 🔥
